body:
With NX8's 8-bit static formats, the tensor that loses most even in its best format is layernorm output in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256: 32.1 dB SQNR (signal-to-quantization-noise ratio; higher is better) in fp8_e2m5, measured on that tensor alone by the format search. Measured on 3 models with a format search (of 279 surveyed).

Model outputs keep a median 16.3 dB SQNR against full precision, the worst 12.7 dB (stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5:vae). 2 of 3 models with a prediction metric (top-1, perplexity or agreement) lose some of it; the most: facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (token agreement 100% → 64%: the share of token positions whose predicted token matches full precision's) and stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5:vae (token agreement 100% → 68%: the share of token positions whose predicted token matches full precision's).

The tensors that lose most in their best format (their own error): layernorm output in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e2m5, 32.1 dB), add output in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e2m5, 34.0 dB), mul output in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e2m5, 34.5 dB), linear output in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e2m5, 35.5 dB), div output in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e2m5, 36.9 dB), linear bias in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e3m4, 37.1 dB), gelu_tanh output in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e3m4, 37.2 dB), silu output in mobilevit_s.cvnets_in1k (fp8_e3m4, 37.2 dB), conv2d bias in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e3m4, 37.3 dB) and groupnorm bias in stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5:vae (fp8_e3m4, 37.4 dB).

Separately, the error accumulated along the data path (every tensor before a node quantized too): mul outputs end furthest from full precision, facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 keeping only -0.8 dB there. The outputs furthest from full precision in each model's best format set: mul in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e2m5, -0.8 dB), linear in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e2m5, 7.6 dB), attention in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e2m5, 9.2 dB), linear in mobilevit_s.cvnets_in1k (fp8_e2m5, 9.2 dB), silu in mobilevit_s.cvnets_in1k (fp8_e2m5, 10.5 dB), attention in mobilevit_s.cvnets_in1k (fp8_e2m5, 11.1 dB), add in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e2m5, 11.3 dB), layernorm in mobilevit_s.cvnets_in1k (fp8_e2m5, 11.5 dB), gelu_tanh in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e2m5, 11.6 dB) and div in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e2m5, 12.5 dB).

Formats chosen (E = exponent bits, M = mantissa bits, u = unsigned): fp8_e2m5 1694 (68%), fp8_e1m6 465 (19%), fp8_e3m4 334 (13%); 0% of tensors use an unsigned format.

A wider format or a per-row choice would recover most where an output's own error in its format, times its data, is largest: silu in stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5:vae (fp8_e2m5, 42.4 dB), conv2d in stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5:vae (fp8_e1m6, 43.4 dB) and upsample in stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5:vae (fp8_e1m6, 43.9 dB).

1 missing capability keep 29 operations in 1 model (of 3 planned) off the chip's direct path; the most widespread is run-time addressing (a load from an address computed on chip) (29 operations in 1 model). Ranked by the MACs they hold:

**Run-time addressing (a load from an address computed on chip).** The chip cannot read memory at an address computed at run time, so every lookup or choice by a run-time value (embedding) needs a workaround. It affects 29 operations in 1 model: 29 calls (1.95% of all calls) and no MACs (data movement only); the biggest: embedding in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256. Cost today: 0 of 29 have a workaround (0 exact, 0 approximate), 0 failed and 29 wait for one; 0 workarounds proposed, 0 passing its check, none evaluated on a model; accuracy not measured yet; cycles not measured yet; 0 extra kernels.

body:
A kernel reads a tensor in the arrangement its writer stored it in; when the reader needs another arrangement, the reading kernel has to rearrange the data itself. This happens to 237 of 340 tensors passed between kernels (70%) in 3 models: 123 for other reshapes, 111 for attention heads split or merged and 3 for image patches.

The reading operations are 163 operations (163 calls, 11% of all calls; 10.9 G MACs, 0.56% of all MACs). The most common causes (writer → reader): linear → attention (attention heads split or merged) 111, linear → add (other reshapes) 58 and linear → mul (other reshapes) 56; most in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (196), mobilevit_s.cvnets_in1k (33) and stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5:vae (8).

Cost today: extra cycles not measured yet (no reading kernel has run); 0 links fail.
title: Layout conversions: 237 of 340 tensors between kernels are rearranged

body:
Activations such as exp, GELU and reciprocal go through a 256-entry lookup table (LUT), which limits their precision: 428 operations in 3 models (428 calls, 29% of all calls), most often silu (142), layernorm (78) and groupnorm (52). Their quantized accuracy: worst 9.2 dB SQNR over 428 measured operations.

Kernels per forward pass (host launches, one per planned kernel call): median 13, most 58 (facebook/DiT-XL-2-256, 58 planned groups), over 3 models.

FP32 headroom (how far the largest value is from FP32 overflow, in powers of ten) is least at 34.4 powers of ten for mul in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (largest value 1.48e+04).

Instruction memory (IMEM, 1,024 words per bank) use: not measured yet (no kernel built).
title: Resource limits: 428 operations limited by the LUT and up to 58 kernel launches per pass

body:
**Costs of the IPU architecture, most costly first:**

1. **Resource limits** hit the most operations: 322 calls (26% of all calls, mostly silu, layernorm and attention) must run through 256-entry LUTs that cap quantized accuracy at a worst 9.2 dB SQNR, and forward passes need a median 35.5 kernel launches (up to 58 in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256).

2. **Layout conversions** affect 229 of 324 inter-kernel tensors (71%, mostly attention head splits/merges after linear), forcing the reading kernel to rearrange data — this touches 155 calls (12%) holding 4.43 G MACs (3.67% of all MACs), though the extra cycles have not been measured and no links fail.

3. **NX8 8-bit formats** (measured on only 3 of 279 surveyed models) cost accuracy: a median 16.3 dB SQNR versus full precision with a worst of 7.4 dB (stable-diffusion-v1-5 VAE), token agreement falling from 100% to 44% (VAE) and 64% (DiT-XL-2-256), accumulated data-path error leaving mul outputs at −0.8 dB in DiT, and layernorm output the worst single tensor at 32.1 dB even in its best format.

4. **Missing run-time addressing** blocks 29 calls (2.32% of calls, no MACs — data movement only, the biggest being embedding in DiT) from running on-chip; zero workarounds exist, are proposed, or are evaluated, so their accuracy and cycle cost are unknown, though adding the capability would put all 29 calls on-chip directly with 0 extra kernels.

5. **Compute efficiency and IMEM use are entirely unmeasured** — no kernel has been built or run — so MAC utilisation and cycle costs per kernel remain unknown across all surveyed models.
